events.title: Deck the Hall | Christmas Tree Competition
events.description:
Get ready to deck the halls and show off your holiday creativity!

Deck the Halls is a festive Christmas tree decorating competition where teams, businesses, organizations, and community members can transform a Christmas tree into their own unique holiday masterpiece.

Decorate during the week of thanksgiving and take down is the first week of January. Choose a theme, gather your team, and let your imagination run wild! Whether your tree is traditional and elegant, hilariously over-the-top, or completely unexpected, we want to see what you can create. Then the community gets to vote! Every penny counts as a vote, and the tree with the most votes wins! The winning group get to choose a local nonprofit to receive ALL of the proceeds! Trees will be on display for the community to enjoy.

It’s a fun way to celebrate the holiday season, showcase local creativity, and bring a little extra Christmas magic to the community.

Think you have what it takes to take home the title?

Grab your ornaments, lights, garland, and your best decorating crew—and get ready to Deck the Halls!

Contact Sami at spettey@co.mckenzie.nd.us to enter, and the entry fee is $20.

events.title: Clay Sculpting Open Studio -November
events.description:
Clay Sculpting Open Studio 👐✨ Join us for a hands-on Clay Sculpting Open Studio where creativity takes shape! Each person receives 1 pound of clay included in the $45 price, with the option to add extra clay for $10 per additional pound.

This is a hand-building experience only—no pottery wheel—just your hands, your imagination, and the tools we provide. Create anything you can dream up! Once your sculpture is complete, we’ll take care of the rest. Your piece will be professionally fired in our kiln, and when it’s ready, you’re invited to return during a Paint Your Own Pottery Open Studio to glaze your creation.

This experience is perfect for both kids and adults, whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned maker. All firings are included in the price, so you can focus on having fun and bringing your ideas to life.

✨ The ideas are limitless—come get your hands dirty and create something truly unique! ✨

events.title: Autumn Royal Icing Class
events.description:
Join Ms. Chloe for the Autumn Royal Icing Class and learn the art of cookie decorating with royal icing in a fun, beginner-friendly setting.

This hands-on, instructional class is perfect for anyone eager to build their decorating skills while creating beautiful seasonal treats.

Each participant will take home a half dozen decorated cookies, including two pumpkin pie slices, two maple leaves, and two cable-knit pumpkins.

Come enjoy a creative afternoon of baking, decorating, and autumn-inspired fun at the Long X Arts Foundation Gallery.

events.title: Artist's Open Studio: November
events.description:
Looking for a creative space to paint, draw, and connect? Join us for Open Studio, a relaxed time for artists of all levels to create, share ideas, and enjoy being part of a supportive art community. Bring your own project, or start something new using our watercolor, oil paint, acrylic, graphite, or charcoal supplies.

This is a non-instructional, self-guided session — but Oksana will be around if you need a little help or feedback along the way. We will have tea available free of charge, also something playing on the tv! If you suggestions, please let us know! Whether you’re just getting started or have years of experience, everyone is welcome here.

Being an artist can sometimes feel lonely, but creating together helps us all grow and stay inspired. By donation • All are welcome Come as you are, create what you love, and enjoy the company of fellow artists. 💛

events.title: Harmony for Hope
events.description:
Join us for a fun, acapella filled evening with amazing drinks, charcuterie, and desserts along with fun auction items!

Harmony for Hope An Evening of Music, Celebration & Giving Join the Benefit Fund of McKenzie Health on Saturday, November 21, 2026, for Harmony for Hope, a special evening bringing our community together in support of McKenzie Health's Cancer Center!

This FREE, semi-formal event will feature an unforgettable a cappella performance by The Coats, along with delicious charcuterie, desserts, and an evening of fun. Alcoholic beverages will be available for purchase.

Break out your sparkles, stylish hats, and favorite semi-formal attire as we celebrate the power of community and generosity! Harmony for Hope will also kick off the Benefit Fund's Giving Tuesday campaign, featuring exciting silent and live auctions benefiting McKenzie Health's Cancer Center. Auction participation is completely optional, and all proceeds will help support exceptional cancer care close to home for patients and families throughout McKenzie County, western North Dakota, and eastern Montana.

And there's a little something extra! The first 100 guests to register will receive a special event gift as a thank-you for joining us! Admission is free, but registration is encouraged. Reserve your spot today and join us for an inspiring evening where music, generosity, and hope come together. Together, we can make a difference—one note, one gift, and one life at a time.

events.title: Midwinter Table: A Badlands Winter Dinner
events.description:
Salted, smoked, cured, cellared, foraged. Executive Chef Candace Stock of Salt + Scoria traces a path from Indigenous foodways through homesteading and ranching to today's regional growers.

Each course features a regional producer, who will be there to explain where the food came from.

Hosted bar reception at 6 p.m., dinner at 7 p.m. Mountain.

$150 per person, including the reception and a three-course plated dinner.

Beer pairing $25, wine pairing $40.

Ages 21 and older.

Seating is limited to 75.

Regular admission applies.
